info.name: Masar API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Masar ride-sharing platform (Driver Flow Audit reorganization, 2026-08-01 + Feature 008: Trip Details, Cancellation & Notification Settings).

Base URL: {{base_url}} (default http://localhost:8000/api).

## Folder organization
- **Auth (shared)** — registration, login, tokens, forgot password, current user.
- **Driver** — Profile & Vehicle, Verification (spec 006: status / submit / resubmit), Trip Management (incl. Get Trip Details, Cancel Trip with Penalty), Dashboard, Bookings, Communication, Ratings & Reviews, Complaints, Penalties, Notifications, Notification Settings, Subscription & Earnings.
- **Passenger** — Trip Discovery, Booking, Tracking, Ratings, Complaints, Request Board, Favorites.
- **Admin** — Subscription Management, Verification Queue, Users Management, Trip Moderation, Arbitration, Penalties, Reports & Analytics.

## Feature 008 — Trip Details, Cancellation & Notification Settings
- **GET /trips/:trip_id** — Enhanced with full driver profile, vehicle info, waypoints, attributes, and passenger booking details. Access restricted to trip participants (driver, confirmed passengers, admins).
- **POST /trips/:trip_id/cancel** — New penalty-aware cancellation. Requires reason + optional note. Only allowed when no confirmed bookings exist. Creates penalty record and applies automatic escalation (warning → 7d suspension → 30d suspension). Bans never auto-created.
- **GET /settings/notifications** — Returns all notification types with enabled/disabled state per channel (in_app, push). Falls back to defaults if no settings exist.
- **PUT /settings/notifications** — Upserts notification preferences. Only provided types are updated.

## Notes
- Requests marked **PROPOSED** (in the description) are not implemented yet; their response examples are proposed designs.
- Every request carries a success + error example.
- Verification endpoints use the `{ "status": "success", "data": {...} }` envelope; admin approve/reject return the raw `{ "driver_id" | "vehicle_id", ... }` payload.
- Token-setting tests on registration/login flows populate {{access_token}}/{{refresh_token}} automatically.
- Error envelope: `{ "status": "error", "message": "...", "code": "..." }`.

## Free Plan
- The free plan is **automatically assigned** to every new driver at signup — no manual subscription required.
- Drivers **cannot** subscribe to the free plan manually (`422 FREE_PLAN_NOT_SUBSCRIBABLE`).
- The admin can create/update/deactivate the free plan via Admin > Subscription Management.
- The free plan's `free_offer` configures the number of free trips (`{ "type": "trips", "value": N }`).
- Once free trips are exhausted, the driver must subscribe to a paid plan to continue.

request.description:
Submit (or resubmit after a rejection) the driver identity + single vehicle package.

Requires role `driver`.

- Idempotent upsert: the profile is created/updated and the driver's single vehicle is updated in place — never duplicated.
- On success the state becomes `pending` and `can_edit` turns `false` until an admin decides.
- Omitted optional fields keep their previous values (partial resubmit). `phone` cannot be changed during verification.
- The vehicle document ids (`registration_doc_front` etc.) must reference existing uploaded images.

**State guards**
- `409 CONFLICT` — already `pending` ("already under review")
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — already `approved` (locked; contact support)
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` — missing required vehicle fields, invalid types/ids, duplicate `plate_number`, or unknown document ids

**Success envelope**: `{ "status": "success", "data": { "status": "pending", "submitted_at": "..." } }`.

Requires role `driver`.

- Omitted optional fields keep their previous values (partial resubmit). `phone` cannot be changed during verification.
- The vehicle document ids (`registration_doc_front` etc.) must reference existing uploaded images.

- `409 CONFLICT` — already `pending` ("already under review")
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — already `approved` (locked; contact support)
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` — missing required vehicle fields, invalid types/ids, duplicate `plate_number`, or unknown document ids

**Success envelope**: `{ "status": "success", "data": { "status": "pending", "submitted_at": "..." } }`.

request.description:
Cancel a trip with automatic penalty recording (US2).

**Access:** Driver who owns the trip only.

**Guards:**
- Trip status must be `published` or `full`
- Zero confirmed bookings (rejects with 409 if any exist)

**Behavior:**
- Sets trip status to `cancelled`
- Creates a penalty record with `penaltyType: trip_cancellation`
- Applies escalation: 3–4 cancels/30d = warning, 5–6 = 7-day suspension, 7+ = 30-day suspension
- Bans are never auto-created
- Notifies passengers via `TRIP_CANCELLED`

**Body fields:**
- `reason` *(string, required, max 500)* — cancellation reason
- `note` *(string, optional, max 500)* — additional note
